Look

Turn order is by Speed and Perception, both teams mixed (the strip above). Space ends your ninja’s turn; H hides the panels. The yellow ring marks who is acting. On your ninja’s turn, click a blue tile to move, or an action and a red target. Over a target: hit % and damage. Arrows show facing: side and behind hit harder. Drag to orbit, scroll to zoom.

Sand village · the crater

A round bowl inside cliffs, nothing like the Leaf's walled grid. One way in: the Cleft, a canyon through the south wall. Eight streets run out from the Kazekage's dome to a ring road; the outer ring sits one step higher, and homes are cut into the cliff walls. Scaffolding marks sites that open over time, as in the Leaf. Gold squares are doors.

Inuzuka · the ninja hound

Your dog from the Academy, growing over the year: pup, young dog, grown, and in Part 2 big enough to ride. It takes its own turn and you control it; at 0 HP it limps off and is back next mission. The red fang marks are the clan's.

 

World map · generated each game

The five villages sit on the rim, with 20 zones between them, rolled fresh each game. Your land has 4 zones, each rival’s 3, and the middle 4 (two small countries, two lawless). Dotted lines are exits, one per side of the arena; a ridge means no way through; dashes over the water are boats. The stronger the colour, the stronger the hold; stripes are a small country’s leader; a small town inside one is its small hidden village (like the Sound). Ranks are for you (numbers PROPOSED).
